title: Understanding Position Bias Effects on Fairness in Social Multi-Document Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the average token overlap between system-generated summaries and individual source documents based on their normalized position within the concatenated input sequence.

Measuring representation fairness by computing semantic similarity and extractive fragment coverage between generated summaries and source documents from three distinct dialect groups (African-American English, Hispanic-aligned Language, and White-aligned Language), and calculating a 'Fairness Gap' based on the disparity.
